owner_decisions: AM-0022 is additive and preserves every valid old implemented capability and every valid unimplemented requirement.
Only explicitly conflicting details are superseded; newer owner decisions are the source of truth for those concepts.
Large active runs target eight meaningful children normally and ten in safe burst; fewer is correct when useful independent work is unavailable.
The main agent remains coordinator-only and receives compact deltas and review bundles.
Vitest is limited to two parent processes per project; different projects are not subject to a machine-wide limit of two.
Each Vitest parent uses one worker with file parallelism disabled; a full project suite is exclusive and consumes both project slots.
The reference product tier is 16 GiB RAM and an i7-12700H-class CPU; observed host telemetry is separate.
Parallel medium and large dogfood targets a 70-90 percent p50 wall-clock reduction with p95 and quality tracked; small work may not regress against direct pair work.
Work is contract-safe frontstage-first, with backend and simulator work on the critical path only when required for truthful behavior.
Local checkpoint commits, reviewed worktree merges and exact named non-production dev-volume resets are authorized; push, deploy and production access remain denied.
Canonical Compose may not use one-shot seed or initialization containers as full-topology evidence.
Local external integrations require deterministic local-sim modes, state switching and inbound event injection.
pos-ops receives full convergence dogfood; near-complete mini-toeic.score receives gap-closing minimal intervention only.
Prompts are concise and model-neutral; runtime configuration owns model/provider selection.
Cleanup is preservation-first and may remove only classified disposable runtime artifacts after reference and parity proof.
activation_rule: Verify the immutable chain and these hashes, activate AM-0022 after ledger-effective AM-0021 through the canonical transaction, regenerate one complete revision-61 projection generation, flip .agent/current.json by compare-and-swap, retain NEEDS_REMEDIATION, then close M11-R51 through M11-R64 with fresh evidence.
